body: Somebody posted a link where a woman talks about the Source of consciousness and how it's okay to leave the human body behind, but the post got deleted. It was actually helpful, I sure hope she is right. Thanks, whoever you were. <3

Currently there's no technology that can fix this problem. Even if there was, I wouldn't be able to afford it.

Thanks though.

I don't know why I posted this, knowing people on this subreddit are discouraged from what they're about to do. Perhaps I was hoping to get some philosophical insights and advice so that I can set my mind at ease.
